title: Pay-Down Margin After a Financial Assistance Decision, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Payments risk memorandum clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the pay-down margin of the reporting-floor pay-down, decided from the latest financial assistance decision on the account's Hardship and Protective Holds records.

## Clause

The pay-down margin is:
- **$25.00** where the latest assistance decision recorded on the account's hardship holds is denied and was recorded in the last 3 months;
- **$10.00** where that latest decision is denied and was recorded 3 or more months before the handling date;
- **$0.01** where the latest recorded decision is not denied, or no decision is recorded.

The margin is added, at its full amount, once the reporting floor has been subtracted, in working out the reporting-floor pay-down.

## Reading the clause

- **Latest assistance decision**: of the assistance-decision records kept with the account's Hardship and Protective Holds records, the one with the latest record date. Its outcome is approved full, approved partial or denied, and its record date is the date it was recorded.
- **Recorded in the last 3 months**: fewer than three whole calendar months separate the record date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month.
- An earlier denial does not count once a later decision with another outcome has been recorded.

## Condition table

| Latest assistance decision | Recorded within the last 3 months | Pay-down margin |
|---|---|---|
| Denied | Yes | $25.00 |
| Denied | No (3 or more months back) | $10.00 |
| Approved full or approved partial | either | $0.01 |
| None recorded | not applicable | $0.01 |

## Hypothetical boundary cases

*Handling date 2026-10-10; invented records.*

| Latest decision | Record date | Whole months back | Margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Denied | 2026-07-11 | 2 | $25.00 |
| Denied | 2026-07-10 | 3 | $10.00 |
| Denied 2026-03-02, then approved partial | 2026-08-19 | 1 | $0.01 |
| None | none | not applicable | $0.01 |
